problem.title: Group Anagrams
problem.statement: Given a list of words, group words that are anagrams (same letters, different order). Example: eat, tea, ate are anagrams.
problem.hint: If you sort the letters of each word, anagrams will have exactly the same form. For example eat becomes aet, tea also becomes aet. What can serve as a grouping key?
problem.walkthrough:
Example words: [eat, tea, tan, ate, nat, bat].

Sort letters of each word:
eat -> aet
tea -> aet
tan -> ant
ate -> aet
nat -> ant
bat -> abt

Now group by sorted form:
aet -> [eat, tea, ate]
ant -> [tan, nat]
abt -> [bat]

Key insight: same sorted letters = anagram. Use the sorted form as a key in a hash map, then put each word into the matching group.
